correctness.rationale: Four-step constructive proof: product is idempotent, its fibers are invariant; the one-root U/V/W partition and independent free choices are bijective; SET of fibers produces the formal EGF and recurrence for all n; identity is unique central map, making graph correction exact. Exact checked by an independently coded brute-force generator for n<=6, plus recurrence through n=10. No computations promoted to infinite proof.

value.rationale: The product rank is a canonical semilattice invariant for two commuting idempotents, and the natural induced commuting graph of full transformation monoids has long been investigated for clique/diameter. The complete n-uniform, rank-refined distribution of all ordered pairs and induced graph edge counts gives strictly more structural information than extremal semilattice size or unrefined idempotent counts; a useful nonarbitrary exact classification.
